scenes.script: A new Fed chair. His first meeting minutes. This week, we finally see what he's really thinking. Here's the week ahead.
scenes.headline:
NEW FED CHAIR.
HIS FIRST
MINUTES.

scenes.script: Wednesday: the Federal Reserve releases minutes from its June meeting — the first under new chair Kevin Warsh. He famously skipped the dot plot, so these minutes are the closest look we'll get at his playbook. Watch how divided the committee was on the next move.
scenes.label: WED · FOMC MINUTES
scenes.headline:
WARSH'S
PLAYBOOK

scenes.script: Thursday: weekly jobless claims. After June added just fifty-seven thousand jobs, one weak number is a blip — two is a trend. If claims climb again, expect rate-hike bets to fade even further.
scenes.label: THU · JOBLESS CLAIMS
scenes.headline:
BLIP,
OR TREND?

big.caption: jobs added in June — half of forecast

scenes.script: And keep an eye on the runway: second-quarter earnings season kicks off next week, with the big banks going first.
scenes.label: NEXT WEEK · Q2 EARNINGS
scenes.headline:
BANKS
GO FIRST

scenes.script: This week is the calm before that storm. A quiet calendar — which is exactly when surprises hit hardest.
scenes.headline:
QUIET
CALENDAR.

scenes.script: That's the week ahead. See you Saturday.
scenes.headline:
SEE YOU
SATURDAY.
